name: 90041 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90041 (Los Angeles) has 110 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 49 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90041 (Los Angeles) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90041 (Los Angeles) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).
